content: One of the most severe problems of NMT is dealing with the rare words, which are not in the short lists of the vocabularies, i.e. out-of-vocabulary (OOV) words, or do not appear in the training set at all. On one hand, we would like to have fewer OOV words by increasing the size of the short lists. On the other hand, we need our neural network to learn fast and has a good generalization capability on the unseen words as well.
